label: Hand-reviewed from the FSRI Eaton timeline: households west of Lake Avenue whose records ask for help getting out, 6 p.m. Jan 7 to noon Jan 8, 2025
source: UL FSRI Southern California Fires Timeline Dataset, Eaton sheet, doi:10.60752/102376.29905157. Row numbers are line numbers in data/eaton/fsri-timeline-eaton.csv.

categories.cannot_leave: The record says the person could not get out without help: elderly, disabled, bedridden, in a wheelchair, or 'needs help evacuating'. These are the people the system calls.
categories.trapped: Trapped by fire at the home or on the street, with nothing said about mobility.
categories.blocked: Tried to leave but the road was blocked.
categories.facility: A care facility evacuated by crews.

requests.outcome: Still asking at 6:37 a.m.: '2 disabled pts stuck in home, backyard now on fire.' No record of anyone reaching them.
requests.note: The 8:28 p.m. request ('two disabled male and female') may be another home on the same block.

requests.outcome: No later record.
A woman in her 90s in hospice care who needed an ambulance. No record of a pickup.
Needed help getting into a vehicle. Law enforcement was sent; no record of arrival.
Elderly woman 'trapped and needs help getting out.' Houses on the block reported burning at 5:13 a.m.
requests.note: Records give both E and W Palm for this block, so it is placed between them at Fair Oaks.

requests.outcome: No later record.
'Unable to evacuate.' The division couldn't make out the address on the radio at 5:08 a.m.
'Evacuation needed for elderly male.' No later record.
Evacuation assist requested. No later record.
'Fire in yard, needs help evac, female elderly,' called in by someone not at the home. No later record.

place.why: OSM has no house numbers on the 100 block of E Harriet; the block starts at Fair Oaks Avenue

requests.outcome: A ham radio operator heard someone asking for help. Dispatch flagged it as a life priority.
At 6:33 a.m. the division said the area was impassable. Three people, one in a wheelchair, were still reported trapped in the garage at 11:52 a.m.
Evacuation assistance requested; at 6:41 a.m., 'stuck in home, front yard on fire.'
'Elderly unable to get out of the house.' No later record.
At 7:18 a.m.: 'resident already evacuated.'
'1 person unable to evacuate, fire is coming into yard.' No later record.
Radio reported a person trapped in a burning home. The Los Angeles Times later reported the coroner confirmed a death at that address.

place.why: the record gives no house number

requests.outcome: Structure fire with an elderly woman trapped inside.
At 6:14 a.m. an investigator found nobody at the address.
At 6:48 a.m.: 'no resident, the house is clear.'
'2 people stuck in house, can't get out due to fire on street.'
At 7:24 a.m. crews got the people to drive out.
A family on the roof spraying hoses; crews made contact and they could get down.
Possible persons trapped. No later record.
'Father is sick and refuses to leave.'
An elderly grandmother wouldn't leave; she was afraid crews would take her dogs.
An elderly woman refused to leave while every home around was burning.
A fallen tree blocked the street. At 4:46 a.m. operations asked for a crew to clear it.

place.why: OSM has no house numbers on El Prieto Road

requests.outcome: A senior living facility. Crews and buses moved about 250 residents; search and rescue called it complete at 11:23 a.m.
requests.note: 4:00 a.m. start from the Citygate report, Table 7.
